name: Byzantine Iconoclasm Controversy
summary: Emperor Leo III orders the destruction of religious images (icons), launching a century-long theological dispute. Pope Gregory III condemns iconoclasm; Leo seizes papal estates in Italy in retaliation. The controversy strains Byzantine-papal relations, pushing the papacy toward the Franks for military protection and accelerating Italy's drift from Byzantine influence.

_quarry.structural_significance: Deepens the theological and political rift between Rome and Constantinople that eventually produces the Great Schism of 1054; the papal turn toward the Franks creates the political conditions for Charlemagne's coronation.
